# `scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/retention.py`

Source: [retention.py](../../../../scripts/pkdgrav3_pipeline/retention.py)

```text
What of a run is kept long term, and where it goes (standard library only: used by the jobs and by
tools/sahyadri_manager on the head node).

Settings (run.conf; defaults in brackets):
  SCRATCH             where the run lives while it is computed (sims/, halos/, state/ below it)
  ARCHIVE             long-term root with the same layout ([empty] = no archive stage)
  KEEP_FULL_Z         full snapshots kept: the planned output nearest each redshift ["0 0.5 1 2 3 5 7"]
  KEEP_FULL_SNAPS     ... or explicit Rockstar snapshot numbers (overrides KEEP_FULL_Z), e.g. "100 93 80"
  KEEP_SUBSAMPLE_PCT  particles kept of every other snapshot, percent [1]; must be a sum of the leading SUBSAMPLES
                      (1,3,5,9,10,12,15,20,25 -> 1, 4, 9, 18, 28, 40, 55, 75, 100); 0 = none
  KEEP_HALO_TABLES    FITS halo tables kept for every snapshot ["basic,extended,tens,vahc"]
  KEEP_TREES          1: merger-tree FITS (whole run) [1]
  KEEP_CHECKPOINT     1: newest complete checkpoint [0]
  ARCHIVE_FILE_MODE   ["0444"]  ARCHIVE_DIR_MODE ["0555"]  (after the archive is checked: read-only for everyone)

usage: retention.py <run.conf> [--list] [--json]     print the resolved plan (and with --list every file)
```

## Contents

- [`load_conf`](#load_conf) - The run configuration as the jobs see it (bash `source` in a clean environment), as a dict.
- [`paths`](#paths) - Directories of the run (same as pipeline\_env.sh), and their archive counterparts.
- [`planned_outputs`](#planned_outputs) - [(snap, step, a, z)] of the planned outputs (output\_steps.txt), else of snapnames.txt (z unknown).
- [`subsample_pcts`](#subsample_pcts) - Particle subsample percentages kept from `SUBSAMPLES` (e.g. `'1,3,5'` -&gt; [1.0, 3.0, 5.0]).
- [`kept_subsamples`](#kept_subsamples) - Leading SUBSAMPLES whose sum is KEEP\_SUBSAMPLE\_PCT (ValueError otherwise).
- [`keep_full_snaps`](#keep_full_snaps) - Rockstar snapshot numbers whose full particle data are kept.
- [`pct_tag`](#pct_tag) - File tag of a subsample percentage: 3 -&gt; `'s03'`.
- [`plan`](#plan) - Resolved retention plan (no file system access beyond output\_steps.txt).
- [`kept_files`](#kept_files) - Every file to archive: [(category, snap or None, source path, path relative to SCRATCH)].
- [`scales_file`](#scales_file) - consistent-trees' snapshot list of this run: &lt;halo dir&gt;/scales.txt (job\_ctrees.pbs copies it there), else the shared &lt;halo dir&gt;/../scales.txt of older runs (overwritten by every realisation's ctrees stage).
- [`content_sha`](#content_sha) - SHA-256 of a text file without its '#' comment lines: the cosmology files shared by the realisations carry the time of the set-up that wrote them in a comment, which says nothing about their content.
- [`human`](#human) - Byte count as a human-readable string (B, KB, MB, GB, TB; powers of 1024).
- [`main`](#main) - Command line: `retention.py <run.conf>`: print the retention plan and the kept files per category with their sizes.
